# Kevin Eaton - Academia

> Kevin Eaton, PhD is a professor teaching Computer Science, Cybersecurity, and Machine Learning at multiple universities.

This site covers his academic background: education, university teaching experience (with course lists by institution), and publications.

## More about Kevin Eaton

- [Hub / all sites](https://kevineaton.net): Links to all of Kevin's professional sites.
- [Technology](https://tech.kevineaton.net): Software architecture, engineering leadership, and entrepreneurship.
- [Military](https://military.kevineaton.net): US Army Reserve service as a Chaplain (Lieutenant Colonel).
- [Martial Arts](https://martialarts.kevineaton.net): Taekwondo, Tangsoodo, Shotokan Karate, and weapons training.
